description: Start a thread in a text or announcement channel: standalone, branched from a message when message_id is given, or private (invite-only) when asked. For a post in a forum channel, use create_forum_post instead.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: Branch the thread from this message (its ID or link).

slowmode_seconds.description: Seconds each member must wait between messages, up to 21600 (6 hours); 0 turns slowmode off.

name: create_thread
title: Create thread
